create_x3d_xs_model: create an X3D-XS video recognition model with 4-frame input clips and 160x160 crop size
create_x3d_s_model: create an X3D-S video recognition model with 13-frame input clips and 160x160 crop size
create_x3d_m_model: create an X3D-M video recognition model with 16-frame input clips and 224x224 crop size
create_x3d_l_model: create an X3D-L video recognition model with 16-frame input clips and 312x312 crop size
create_x3d_pretrained_model: create a pretrained X3D model by loading Kinetics checkpoint weights from the model zoo
